remarks: Welcome to 26611 Avenida Deseo in the heart of Mission Viejo! This charming single-story home offers 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and 1,124 square feet of inviting living space, combining comfort, style, and Southern California living. Enter to discover a newly painted bright and airy interior featuring vaulted ceilings, recessed lighting, plantation shutters, and a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace. The thoughtfully designed floor plan flows into a dedicated dining area and a beautifully appointed kitchen featuring New cabinetry, new  stainless steel appliances, and new ample counter space.
